headline: Mikel Merino says Arsenal are 'ready' for Premier League, Champions League double
description: Mikel Merino insists Arsenal are ready to go one better than last season and complete a Premier League and Champions League double.

headline: Andy Burnham: Man City owners didn't mention Premier League charges in meeting
description: Andy Burnham has said Manchester City's owners and directors did not raise the Premier League's charges against the club when he met with them.

headline: Fulham's Arbeloa fined for ref comments after Man United draw
description: Fulham's Álvaro Arbeloa was fined $33,200 and given a warning for his comments after a match against Man United that questioned the integrity of the referee.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Real Madrid, Barcelona chase Spurs defender Porro
description: Tottenham defender Pedro Porro is being tracked by Real Madrid and Barcelona. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Chelsea confident in January move for Scott
description: Chelsea are growing confident of signing Bournemouth's Alex Scott. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Lisandro Martínez slams Man United hierarchy: Squad not Champions League quality
description: Lisandro Martínez launched a stinging verbal attack on Manchester United's hierarchy, after a 2-0 Champions League defeat against Atlético Madrid.
